data.title: 矢来美羽 · 值班台的电话
data.description: 值班电话响起时，美羽把记录本翻到空白页，一边接听一边准备记下地点。
data.action: holding a telephone receiver beside an open notebook
data.lighting: 海上特区警备值班室暖黄台灯与监控屏幕幽蓝微光
data.promptProse: Seated in front of a multi-monitor console in the security station, Miu adjusts her headset microphone while scanning status reports on the screens. Clean indoor lighting illuminates her desk, control panels, and attentive expression.
data.animaCaption: A cozy desk lamp and glowing monitors light up the dispatch room as Miu holds the phone with a tender, flushed expression.
